info.title: Azure Monitor Health Models Data Plane

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The Azure region hosting the health model's data plane.

AadOauth2Auth.description: The Azure Active Directory OAuth2 Flow

get.description: Return whether the health model exists and its current health state.
Return the health-state periods active during the requested window for an entity.

parameters.name: entityName
parameters.description: The entity to return health-state history for.

parameters.name: endAt
parameters.description: End of the requested window (UTC); defaults to now when omitted.

EntityHealthStateHistoryResponse.description: Health-state periods overlapping the requested window, newest first.

value.description: The health-state periods, ordered newest first.

EntityHealthStatePeriod.description: A contiguous interval during which the entity held a single health state.

healthState.description: Health state held during this period — typically one of Unknown, Healthy, Degraded, or Unhealthy. The value as recorded; an open string, not a closed enum.

startAt.description:
When this state became active (UTC). Omitted when the state was already active at the
earliest point observable from retained data — i.e. its true start is older than the
~30-day data-retention window, predates the entity's first recorded transition, or lies
beyond the result cap.

endAt.description:
When the entity transitioned away from this state (UTC). Omitted when the state is still
active now (no later transition recorded).

QueryEchoResponse.description: Health state of the requested health model, echoed by the status endpoint.

healthModelExists.description: True when a health model exists for the requested id.

healthModelState.description: Health state of the health model; null when the health model does not exist.

entityName.description: Entity resource name; matches the control-plane proxy-resource naming contract.
